props.name: steps
props.description: The steps, in order, after the starting value.

props.name: start
props.description: Opening value, drawn as the first bar. Omit to start from zero with no bar.

props.name: startLabel
props.description: Axis label for the opening bar.

props.name: height
props.description: Plot height in pixels. The width fills the container.

props.name: format
props.description: Format values on the axis, the bars and the tooltip.

props.name: showValues
props.description: Print each bar's change or total above it.

props.name: showConnectors
props.description: Draw the dashed line carrying each level across to the next bar.

props.name: showLegend
props.description: Show the increase / decrease / total key.
